headline: Pakistan Government Rejects $490 Million Foreign Loan Over Cost
summary: The Pakistani government has rejected a proposed $490 million foreign loan due to concerns over its high borrowing costs.
why: Decisions to reject high-cost sovereign debt reflect fiscal discipline constraints and influence national foreign exchange reserve management.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Avoiding expensive external debt limits immediate financing inflows but prevents additions to high-interest sovereign debt liabilities.
